instructions: Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
ARDLEIGH COLLEGE - HALL OF RESIDENCE APPLICATION

Applicant
Surname: (1) ........
Course: (2) ........ (three-year programme)
Address: (3) ........, Marsden

Halls open to first-year applicants
Thornbury Hall: closed to applicants this year - the building is being (4) ........
Wharton Court: study bedroom, kitchen shared with five other students, £118 a week
Cadnam House: bigger kitchens; every room is (5) ........
Rent at Cadnam House from September: £(6) ........ a week

Contract (38 weeks)
Rooms are emptied over the spring break, but (7) ........ may be left in the basement store room
Completed form must reach the office by (8) ........ June

Arrival
Keys are handed out at the (9) ........ on Cadnam Street
Write reference (10) ........ on anything sent to the office

items.explanation: The surname is spelt out letter by letter on the recording: B-R-A-T-H-W-A-I-T-E; the student also adds that there is no extra letter in the middle.

items.evidence: Environmental Engineering. It's the three-year one
items.explanation: The student names the course and immediately adds that it is the three-year programme, not the four-year version with a placement.

items.evidence: It's twenty-two Hartlow Road, in Marsden.
items.explanation: The address is given in words: twenty-two Hartlow Road; the town name (Marsden) is already given on the form.

items.prompt: Thornbury Hall: closed to applicants this year - the building is being (4) ........
items.evidence: Thornbury is being re-roofed over the winter, so we've taken it out of the offer this year
items.explanation: Although the student's friend suggests Thornbury, the hall is closed to applicants this year: its roof is being renewed over the winter.

items.prompt: Cadnam House: bigger kitchens; every room is (5) ........
items.evidence: the rooms there are en-suite — you have your own shower room
items.explanation: Because Cadnam House is a newer block, the rooms have their own shower room; the adviser calls this en-suite.
items.flag_reason: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: karşı satır Wharton'ı 'mutfağı beş kişiyle paylaşılan' diye tanımlıyor, öğrenci konaklamasında kalan tek ayrım banyolu (en-suite) oda.

items.prompt: Rent at Cadnam House from September: £(6) ........ a week
items.evidence: from September it's a hundred and forty-five, I'm afraid
items.explanation: The student brings up the figure of one hundred and thirty-two from the website, but that is from last year; from September the en-suite room is one hundred and forty-five pounds a week.

items.prompt: Rooms are emptied over the spring break, but (7) ........ may be left in the basement store room
items.evidence: You can leave one box in the store room in the basement, but otherwise the rooms have to be cleared.
items.explanation: Because the contract is shorter, the halls close over the spring break; only one box per person can be left in the basement store room.

items.prompt: Completed form must reach the office by (8) ........ June
items.evidence: For accommodation you've got until the thirtieth.
items.explanation: The twenty-third that the student notes down is the deadline for the scholarship application; the deadline for the accommodation form is the thirtieth of June.

items.prompt: Keys are handed out at the (9) ........ on Cadnam Street
items.evidence: From the porter's lodge on Cadnam Street.
items.explanation: Most students go to the main reception first, but the keys are not kept there; the keys are collected from the porter's lodge on Cadnam Street.

items.prompt: Write reference (10) ........ on anything sent to the office
items.evidence: your reference is H-R, nine four two
items.explanation: The application reference given at the end of the conversation is H-R, nine four two; the student repeats it to confirm.
